verification_records.proposed_value: stipend
verification_records.conflict_or_limitation_notes: Independent re-fetch of TUM's official Deutschlandstipendium page (src-17) on 2026-09-24: TUM's own English-language page consistently uses 'scholarship' (e.g. 'Deutschlandstipendium scholarship holders', 'not purely a merit-based scholarship'); the German name 'Deutschlandstipendium' itself translates literally to 'Germany Stipend'. Structurally the award is a fixed EUR 300/month recurring payment for the standard period of study, subject to annual renewal criteria -- the schema's 'stipend' category (distinct from a one-off 'fixed_amount' or a 'full_tuition'/'partial_tuition' waiver) is the accurate structural classification and matches the award's own German name. No change to the existing value was needed; this VerificationRecord closes the coverage gap for a field that was already correct.
